title: Vault Usage — payload
description: Consumer queries the maintainer's audit log of recent vault uses (proxy-logins, releases). Drives UIs like "recent activity" and "which AI agent has been using my GitHub credential". Read-only.

entryId.description: Optional filter — usage for this entry only.

contextId.description: Optional filter — usage within this trust context only.

byConsumer.description: Optional filter — usage by this consumer DID only. Useful for "what has AI agent X been doing on my behalf".

since.description: Optional filter — only uses whose `occurredAt` is at or after this instant (an inclusive lower bound).

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most usage records to return; the responder chooses a default and MAY return fewer.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation token for the next page, sent back as the request's `cursor`. Present when more matching records remain; absent on the last page.

consumerDid.description: DID of the Companion/Service that initiated the use.

sessionId.description: For successful proxy-logins, the maintainer-assigned session id; absent for releases and for failures.

policyDecisionId.description: Pointer to the policy evaluation record for forensic detail.

errorCode.description: Trust Task error code when outcome is a failure.
